meta.note: gdp_nominal is a NOMINAL series. The deflator is not an independent index: it is the ratio of the two GDP levels.

The NSO's own back-cast of the national accounts onto the 2011-12 base. Real growth is computed from constant-price levels; saving and investment rates are shares of nominal GDP. A separate bundle: it is never joined to the current 2011-12 or 2022-23 series.
gdp_nominal is a NOMINAL series. The deflator is not an independent index: it is the ratio of the two GDP levels.
